name: flashspace
description: FlashSpace — ephemeral, purpose-based cloud workspaces with lifecycle-aware storage

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @flashspace/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @flashspace/shared && npm run build --workspace @flashspace/api && npm run build --workspace @flashspace/web
